dedupe_keys.name: economic potentials of district heating in austria

description: This data set gives the results of an assessment of the economic potential of district heating in Austria, together with site-level data on existing grids and heat sources. It was published by Mostafa Fallahnejad, Marcus Hummel and Lukas Kranzl to show where district heating is cheaper than decentral heat supply. Files cover district heating grids in Austria by grid, industrial waste heat potentials by site at two temperature levels (at least 100 and below 100 degrees Celsius), thermal power plants and combined heat and power plants by site, the share of district heating areas that are not economic, the aggregated economic potential compared with total space heating and hot water demand, heat supply by energy carrier, and the spatial outline of potential district heating areas, each from a financial and an economic perspective. Coverage is Austria at site and area level. The data are CSV tables and area files in one ZIP of about 1.2 MB on Zenodo (version 1.1, May 2022) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: potentials are model results for one set of assumptions, and the grid and plant lists are snapshots. Simulation uses are district heating expansion and heat source planning. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
